name: Piece of Lambda
detailed_description:
Belonging to NIJISANJI: Lize Helesta/Ange Katrina/Inui Toko, a.k.a. "Sanbaka"

What if “Page of Lambda” had been made into a game? A dramatic RPG about love and friendship nurtured through travel.

The Kingdom of Helesta is a land of water where humans and demons live together. Lise Helesta, the second princess of the Kingdom of Helesta, sets out on a journey as part of her royal training, carrying a treasured sword handed down from mythology. On her way, she meets “Ange Katrina” and “Inui Toko”.

For training, for refining their boyfriends, and for their demon friends. The three of them, with different purposes, decided to travel together.

In the sandy land of “Ovix,” the player sees a “demon hunt” in which demons are executed one after another...

Dramatic RPG depicting “love” and “friendship” nurtured through travel.

This is a fan-made game. It has nothing to do with NIJISANJI or ANYCOLOR Inc.

Lize Helesta

She is the second princess of the Kingdom of Helesta. She is a gifted woman of both literary and military prowess, serious, kind to all, and well-liked. As heir to the throne, she trains herself both mentally and physically, and gathers information from home and abroad.

At the age of 17, she sets out on a journey with the “Helesta Saber,” a treasured sword that has been handed down in the Helesta family for generations, as part of her royal training.

Ange Katrina

He and Lize are old acquaintances. She retreats to a battered hut on the outskirts of the forest in the kingdom of Helesta and devotes herself to her research, forgetting about food and sleep. While researching alchemy, she has been traumatized in the past.

She leaves home for “Lakimy,” the sacred place of alchemy, to smelt her boyfriend, but meets Lizée by chance on her journey.

Inui Toko

Cerberus was born and raised in Hell. As a long-lived beast race, he has long observed the relationship between the world and human society. He has a savage personality and is somewhat optimistic. His beautiful singing voice is said to have the effect of healing a wounded heart.

When she hears that demons are being harmed in the human world, she leaves hell behind. When she was injured while protecting a demon, Lize and Ange saved her, and they travel together.
